name: ui-scroll-full
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game UI keyframe, fully unrolled story parchment
Primary request: One very tall parchment scroll viewed straight-on, fully opened vertically. The BLANK cream paper sheet must be extremely broad, occupying at least 82% of the complete scroll width from ragged paper edge to ragged paper edge. Short wonky wooden spindle ends may project only slightly beyond the paper at top and bottom. Small dusty teal cloth ties wrap the spindle near each end.
Input images: attached sheep, gate, patched sail, and compact scroll are style references only. Match their deliberately primitive old Windows MS Paint mouse-doodle construction.
Style/medium: chunky true-black jagged stair-stepped outlines, visibly lopsided handmade silhouette, flat bucket fills, sparse brown single-pixel crease marks confined to the outermost paper edges.
Composition/framing: isolated centered tall scroll, whole silhouette fully visible, 4% transparent margin. The inner 72% of the entire canvas width and the middle 75% of its height must be near-uniform blank pale cream for legible HTML text. Keep the paper broad and nearly rectangular, with only mild wobbles at its edges.
Color palette: cream paper, mustard accents, warm brown wood, dusty teal ties.
Constraints: true transparent alpha outside the object with no translucent haze or vignette; no text, runes, letters, icons, characters, drop shadow, gradients, glossy light, polished vector curves, watermark. One scroll only.
